title: RuneScape Dragonwilds: Regicide Quest Guide – Quick & Easy for All Players!
author: RuneScape Universe
description:
RuneScape Dragonwilds Regicide quest guide and full Scorned Wilderness raid walkthrough! In this guide, I’ll show you how to complete Regicide, solve every major puzzle, defeat the raid enemies and Black Dragons, find Sanguine Urns, and defeat Kuldra, the God-Eater.

Icthlarin’s Little Helper Quest Guide - https://youtu.be/CGKbJnASBwc

Regicide requires you to complete Icthlarin’s Little Helper first. After that, we’ll travel back through the Fractured Plains and enter the Scorned Wilderness to begin the raid.

Throughout the guide, I’ll show you the full route through the Scorned Wilderness, including Anima puzzles, Pylons, Anima Orbs, Crystallised Anima, checkpoints, Guardians, Abyssal Demon, Black Dragons, Cataclysm Keep and the final Kuldra boss fight.

I’ll also show you where to gather new materials for Power Level 8 progression, useful resources throughout the raid, Sanguine Urn locations for permanent health increases, and my small raid base setup for quickly preparing food, potions and equipment.

Kuldra has four main fight phases. I’ll explain how to create Anima Orbs, activate the Pylons, power the Anima Cannon, survive Kuldra’s attacks and complete the final fight inside Kuldra against her heart.

After completing Regicide, you’ll unlock rewards including the Dragon Kiteshield, Dragonslayer’s Cape, Queenslayer’s Reward Pack, Lougrim’s Staff and full access to the Scorned Wilderness raid.
